name: Comments
description: A conversation on the instance: messages, each top-level or a reply in the thread of a top-level one, one level deep, which their authors edit and delete, others react to and pin, and whose threads are resolved and reopened. A message may be streamed as it is written: begin holds its place as composing, appendDraft adds to its draft and sends the draft signal to the streams open on the instance, and finish posts it; one whose author stops appending for composeTimeoutMs is interrupted, keeping what was written. Readers send typing and viewing, signals the engine delivers and does not keep. Every writing operation is beside the instance: it writes Comments' own tables, never moves the instance's seq, ETag or updatedAt, and runs none of its guards, so a lease on the instance does not stop a reply. A caller who may read the instance reads the conversation; the policy is asked write for a writing operation, post included. Deleting the instance deletes its conversation.

maxBodyLength.description: The longest body a post, an edit or a finish may give, and the longest draft appendDraft builds, in code points; 40000 when absent.

editWindowMs.description: How long after a message's postedAt its author may edit it, in milliseconds; no limit when absent. A caller holding moderatePermission is not held to it.

composeTimeoutMs.description: How long a composing message's author may append nothing before the engine's runner interrupts it, in milliseconds; 60000 when absent. The runner looks for such messages every quarter of it, or every 15 seconds when that is sooner.

maxDrafts.description: The most composing messages one subject may have on an instance at once; begin refuses another. 5 when absent.

blocks.description: The block kinds a post, an edit or a finish may give; every kind when absent, none when empty.

moderatePermission.description: The permission that lets a caller edit, delete and interrupt another's message, edit past editWindowMs, and purge. Absent, only a message's author edits, deletes or interrupts it before composeTimeoutMs passes, and nobody purges.

pinPermission.description: The permission a caller needs to pin and unpin. Absent, any caller the policy lets write may.

resolvePermission.description: The permission that lets a caller resolve and reopen another's thread. Absent, only a thread's author does.

fields.name: messages
fields.description: How many posted and interrupted messages the conversation has, top-level and replies; composing, deleted and purged ones are not counted.

fields.name: lastMessageAt
fields.description: The greatest postedAt of a posted or interrupted message, in epoch milliseconds; absent while there is none.

fields.name: threads
fields.description: The posted and interrupted top-level messages, each a thread, whether resolved or not: { open, resolved }.

fields.name: composing
fields.description: The subjects writing a message now: each subject with a composing message on the instance, once, in the order of its earliest composing message's id; empty while nobody is.

operations.name: post
operations.description: Posts a message as the caller: top-level, or a reply in the thread of a top-level message, which may quote a message of that thread. A composing message has no thread to reply in and cannot be quoted. A ref block's instance must be one the caller may read, and each block's kind one the config allows. A retry with the clientId of a message the caller posted or began returns that message and posts nothing.

body.description: The text, Markdown, at most the config's maxBodyLength code points.

blocks.description: Structured parts beside the body, each of a kind the config allows.

items.description: A block, checked against its kind.

oneOf.description: Another instance of the namespace, which the poster must be able to read when the block is posted; a reader's own read decides whether it opens.
A card for something the poster did, "ran the tests" say; an edit moves its status.

data.description: What a client shows with it, at most 8192 bytes as compact JSON.

mentions.description: The subjects the message names for someone to hear of it: a person's, an agent's or a group's (role:<name>), as the client resolved them from what was typed.

thread.description: The id of the top-level message to reply in; a top-level message when absent.

quotes.description: The id of the message of the thread the reply quotes, the top-level one or a reply; needs thread.

clientId.description: The caller's key for the message, so a retry returns the message it posted.

operations.name: begin
operations.description: Begins a message as the caller, composing: it takes its id and its place in the conversation now, top-level or a reply in the thread of a top-level message, which may quote a message of that thread, and shows the caller as writing. Its author adds the text with appendDraft and posts it with finish; one whose author appends nothing for the config's composeTimeoutMs is interrupted. Nothing is counted until it is finished or interrupted. A caller may have at most the config's maxDrafts composing messages on the instance. A retry with the clientId of a message the caller posted or began returns that message and begins nothing.

operations.name: appendDraft
operations.description: Appends text to the draft of the caller's composing message, and once the call commits sends the draft signal, { message, offset, text }, to the streams open on the instance. A reader that opens the conversation midway reads the draft so far as the message's body and follows the signals from its length. Its author only; the draft holds at most the config's maxBodyLength code points. An empty text appends nothing and sends nothing, and still counts as an append, so an author at work with nothing to show keeps its message from being interrupted. It appends no event.

message.description: The id of the composing message.

text.description: The text to append, at most 4000 bytes written as a JSON string, its quotes included, so that the draft signal fits a signal's 4096 bytes.

offset.description: The draft's length before the append, in code points: where the text starts.

length.description: The draft's length after the append, in code points.

operations.name: finish
operations.description: Posts the caller's composing message: its body is body, or the draft when body is absent, checked as a post's body is, and its blocks and mentions are as a post gives them. Its author only. The message keeps its id, its place and the createdAt its begin gave it, and is counted from now.

operations.name: interrupt
operations.description: Stops a composing message: it becomes interrupted, its draft its body, or deleted when its draft holds no text. Its author may at any time, and so may a caller holding moderatePermission; any caller the policy lets write may once the author has appended nothing for the config's composeTimeoutMs, which is how the engine's runner interrupts a message whose author has stopped, on its schedule. An interrupted message is counted from now.

before.description: The page is the latest messages with a lower id.

after.description: The page is the earliest messages with a higher id.

limit.description: At most this many messages; 50 when absent.

signals.name: typing
signals.description: The sender is typing a message: top-level, or with thread a reply in that thread. A client sends it every few seconds while its person types, and a reader shows the sender as typing for a few seconds after the last; the engine keeps none. Comments does not check that thread names a message.

thread.description: The id of the top-level message whose thread the sender is typing in; absent for a top-level message.

signals.name: viewing
signals.description: The sender has the conversation open. A client sends it every few seconds while it shows the conversation, and a reader shows the sender as looking for a few seconds after the last; the engine keeps none.

signals.name: draft
signals.description: Text appendDraft added to a composing message's draft, sent once its call commits; from is the message's author. A reader that holds offset code points of the draft appends text; one that holds fewer missed a signal and reads the message again with getMessage; one that holds more ignores it.

message.description: The id of the composing message.

offset.description: The draft's length before the text, in code points.

vetoes.description: The id a call names, as message, thread, quotes or around, is not a message of the conversation, or a purged one; or around names a message outside the listing. details: message.
thread names a reply, not a top-level message: post, begin, listMessages, resolve and reopen. details: message, thread, the reply's thread.
post or begin with quotes naming a message outside the thread it replies in. details: message, thread.
An edit, delete, reaction, pin, resolve or reopen of a deleted message, or a post or begin quoting one. details: message.
An edit, reaction, pin, resolve or reopen of a composing message, a post or begin replying in the thread of a composing top-level message, or quoting a composing message. details: message.
appendDraft, finish or interrupt of a message that is posted, interrupted or deleted. details: message, state.

An edit or delete of another's message, or a resolve or reopen of another's thread, by a caller without moderatePermission (resolvePermission for a thread); or appendDraft or finish of another's composing message, which nobody but its author writes. details: message, author.
An edit by the message's author more than the config's editWindowMs after its postedAt. details: message, postedAt, editWindowMs.
An edit of a message that has been edited 500 times. details: message, max.
react with an emoji the caller has already given the message. details: message, emoji.
unreact of an emoji the caller has not given the message. details: message, emoji.
react with a 21st distinct emoji on a message. details: message, max.
pin of a pinned message. details: message.
unpin of a message that is not pinned. details: message.
resolve of a resolved thread. details: thread, by, at.
reopen of a thread that is not resolved. details: thread.
A block of a kind the config's blocks does not list. details: block, its index in blocks; kind; allowed.
A ref block whose instance does not exist or the caller may not read, the same refusal for both. details: block, schema, id.

interrupt of another's composing message, by a caller without moderatePermission, whose author appended less than the config's composeTimeoutMs ago. details: message, author, lastAppendAt, composeTimeoutMs.
begin by a caller that has the config's maxDrafts composing messages on the instance already. details: composing, how many it has; max.
appendDraft whose text would make the draft longer than the config's maxBodyLength. details: message, length, append, maxBodyLength.
purge on a type whose config names no moderatePermission. details: permission, "moderatePermission".
